name: price_track
summary: Track the prices of specific product pages over time (competitor listings on Amazon, eBay or any shop; links or Amazon ASINs): price, stock and seller, with an alert when a price drops or reaches a target ('Preis beobachten', 'watch my competitors' prices', 'tell me when … drops below …'). For NEW listings of a search use monitor_create.

args.products: string[]: product URLs or Amazon ASINs
args.alert: string: when to alert in the user's words ('below 300 €', 'any drop')
args.name: string: short label (optional)
